privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.intro.text: SnapSong is designed with privacy at its core. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
privacy.collect.title: What We Collect
privacy.collect.photos.title: Photos and Images
privacy.collect.photos.text: When you use SnapSong, you choose which photos to upload for song generation. Photos are temporarily sent to OpenAI's Vision API for analysis, then deleted from their servers. You maintain full ownership of your original photos, which are stored locally on your device only.
privacy.collect.usage.title: Usage Data
privacy.collect.usage.text: We collect basic analytics: how many songs you generate, which features you use, and crash reports. This data helps us improve the app and identify bugs. We never collect the content of your songs, lyrics, or personal metadata about your photos.
privacy.collect.diagnostics.title: Diagnostic Data
privacy.collect.diagnostics.text: Apple's on-device diagnostics may be enabled. This data is collected directly by Apple and is subject to Apple's privacy policy. It includes app performance metrics and may be shared with app developers in aggregated form only.
privacy.use.title: How We Use Your Information
privacy.use.text: We use collected data solely to operate and improve SnapSong. We analyze usage patterns to understand which features are popular, which helps us prioritize development. We may also use diagnostic data to fix crashes and improve performance. We never sell your data. We never use your photos, songs, or personal information for machine learning training or any other purpose beyond generating your song.
privacy.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
privacy.thirdParty.openai.title: OpenAI (Vision & Text Generation)
privacy.thirdParty.openai.text: When you generate a song, we send your photo and context keywords to OpenAI's APIs. OpenAI's privacy policy applies to this data. Specifically: photos are used only to analyze the image and generate lyrics, then immediately deleted. OpenAI may use aggregated, de-identified data to improve their models, but not your specific images.
privacy.thirdParty.suno.title: Suno (Audio Generation)
privacy.thirdParty.suno.text: Lyrics and style metadata generated by OpenAI are sent to Suno to create the audio. Suno's privacy policy applies. Like OpenAI, Suno may use aggregated data to improve their models, but your specific songs and lyrics are not used to train their system without your consent.
privacy.thirdParty.apple.title: Apple Intelligence
privacy.thirdParty.apple.text: SnapSong may use Apple Intelligence features (on-device processing) for smart suggestions and personalization. These features run entirely on your device — no data leaves your phone or iPad. Your data is never sent to Apple's servers for these features.
privacy.thirdParty.noSale: We do not sell your data to advertisers, data brokers, or any third party. Period.
privacy.storage.title: How We Store Your Data
privacy.storage.text: Your photos, songs, and generated lyrics are stored locally on your device only. No data is synced to cloud servers controlled by SnapSong. If you use iCloud backup, your songs may be backed up as part of your app's local storage — this is controlled entirely by Apple's iCloud system, not by us.
privacy.onDevice.title: On-Device Processing
privacy.onDevice.text: SnapSong is designed to keep as much processing on your device as possible. Apple Intelligence features, playback controls, and history management all happen locally. The only data that leaves your device is what you explicitly choose to send to OpenAI and Suno for song generation.
privacy.retention.title: Data Retention
privacy.retention.text: Your songs are stored on your device indefinitely until you delete them. Analytics data is retained for up to 90 days, then deleted. If a crash occurs, diagnostic data is stored briefly for debugging, then removed. OpenAI and Suno's retention policies apply to data sent to their servers — see their privacy policies for details.
privacy.children.title: Children's Privacy
privacy.children.text: SnapSong is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 13, we will delete it immediately.
privacy.rights.title: Your Rights
privacy.rights.text: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your data. Because your data is stored on your device, you can delete it at any time by removing songs from the app or uninstalling SnapSong. For data sent to OpenAI and Suno, you must contact those companies directly to exercise your rights.
privacy.changes.title: Changes to This Policy
privacy.changes.text: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of material changes via in-app notification or by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of SnapSong after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.contact.title: Contact Us
privacy.contact.text: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us at privacy@snapsong.app or through the app's contact form. We aim to respond within 30 days.
